name: event.feed
description: Names the Mission Events outlet that is this brand, by its id, and starts the hourly pull of its events (event.tick) at once, as the caller. Null stops the pull. A new outlet removes the brand's events; the pull brings the new outlet's. Only the company's owners and admins, themselves (never an agent), and only for a company on the operator's list (event_orgs).
sql:
with old as (
  select f.outlet_id from brandbase.event_feeds f where f.brand_id = :brand
),
stopped as (
  delete from brandbase.event_feeds f where f.brand_id = :brand and :outlet::uuid is null
  returning f.brand_id
),
cleared as (
  delete from brandbase.events e where e.brand_id = :brand
    and not exists (select 1 from old where old.outlet_id = :outlet::uuid)
  returning e.id
),
armed as (
  insert into brandbase.event_feeds (brand_id, outlet_id, next_at)
  select :brand, :outlet::uuid, :now::timestamptz where :outlet::uuid is not null
  on conflict (brand_id) do update set outlet_id = excluded.outlet_id, next_at = excluded.next_at,
    pulled_at = case when brandbase.event_feeds.outlet_id = excluded.outlet_id then brandbase.event_feeds.pulled_at end
  returning brand_id, outlet_id, next_at
)
select jsonb_build_object('brand', :brand, 'outlet', (select a.outlet_id from armed a),
    'removed', (select count(*) from cleared)) as result,
  (select jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
     'op', 'event.tick', 'at', brandbase.iso(a.next_at), 'key', a.brand_id || ':' || brandbase.iso(a.next_at),
     'input', jsonb_build_object('brand', a.brand_id, 'at', brandbase.iso(a.next_at))))
   from armed a) as schedule
